label: start
name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All 9 trials scored exactly 0 on dev and also on training (sampled) success. That held across three architecture families and recipes from 120k to 400k steps. The world probably differs from the description in a way that local convolutions cannot absorb. The flat linear head was too weak to compensate, and more samples, entropy changes and a DONE redesign did nothing. Remapping channels is already learnable through the 1x1 stems. Anchor shifts of about one cell were covered by the 3x3 heads in r3c2. Two causes remain untested: a spatial mismatch between the observation grid and the action grid (transpose or flip), and a more arbitrary cell mapping. The last round tests both. One candidate adds explicit flipped and transposed copies of the features to the head. One uses attention with learned positions, which can learn any mapping. One combines the two. Any nonzero score beats the baseline.
